charaepi_ch0201_00_jindai/2301_1101_100_:
While walking along a mountain path,
[Name:PlayerNickname ] came across
Brandon.
charaepi_ch0201_00_jindai/2301_1201_100_:
Hahahah! [Name:PlayerNickname ]!
Have you also come seeking adventure?
charaepi_ch0201_00_jindai/2301_0401_100_:
I am! A new one awaits me deep in these
mountains!
charaepi_ch0201_00_jindai/2301_0402_100_:
Why, of course! I’m heading into these
mountains on a quest for adventure!
charaepi_ch0201_00_jindai/2301_1201_200_:
Articuno has been scouting for me from
a bird’s-eye view, you see.
charaepi_ch0201_00_jindai/2301_1201_300_:
It’s also been detecting danger alongside my
courage sensor...
charaepi_ch0201_00_jindai/2301_1201_400_:
and finding new places to explore, like
suspicious caves!
charaepi_ch0201_00_jindai/2301_1201_500_: I met Articuno deep in the mountains, too.
charaepi_ch0201_00_jindai/2301_1201_600_:
It was during a blizzard so ferocious,
I couldn’t see an inch from my face!
charaepi_ch0201_00_jindai/2301_1201_800_:
I had my own wits! My own strength!
My own Pokémon!
charaepi_ch0201_00_jindai/2301_1201_900_:
And above all, I had my own courage that
allowed me to stand tall and face Articuno!
charaepi_ch0201_00_jindai/2301_1201_1000: As a result, I managed to befriend Articuno.
charaepi_ch0201_00_jindai/2301_1201_1100:
Next thing I knew, Articuno’s blizzard
subsided, revealing a resplendent sunset!
charaepi_ch0201_00_jindai/2301_1201_1200:
That was the moment I knew Articuno
accepted me!
charaepi_ch0201_00_jindai/2301_1201_1300: Oh, how I wanted to run off into that sunset!
charaepi_ch0201_00_jindai/2301_1201_1400:
But I couldn’t, because I was on a mountain!
Hahahah!
charaepi_ch0201_00_jindai/2301_1201_1500:
That’s when I remembered I needed to hurry
back to my mountain hut before sundown.
charaepi_ch0201_00_jindai/2301_1201_1600: So I descended the mountain...on skis!
charaepi_ch0201_00_jindai/2301_1201_1700:
As I skied, Articuno flew right above me the
whole way down! It was exhilarating!
charaepi_ch0201_00_jindai/2301_0401_200_:
Hahahah! It truly was a grand adventure!
Grand it was, indeed!
charaepi_ch0201_00_jindai/2301_0302_200_: Tell me more about your adventures!
charaepi_ch0201_00_jindai/2301_1201_1800:
Like with Articuno, I have an adventurous
tale for how I met each of my Pokémon!
charaepi_ch0201_00_jindai/2301_1201_1900:
[Name:PlayerNickname ]! You must have
stories of how you first encountered your
Pokémon, correct?
charaepi_ch0201_00_jindai/2301_1201_2000:
It’s remarkable how every adventurer has
exuberant stories! Yes, grand, it is! Eh?
